+// Why a backend cannot be used in this browser, on this build. An empty reason

+const AVAILABILITY = {

+  [TauriAdapter.type]: tauriUnavailability,
+  [S3Adapter.type]: WORKS,
+  [MemoryAdapter.type]: WORKS,

 /**

+ * The sources this build can offer, here, now, and why any of them cannot.
+ *
+ * Two different things look alike from the form's side and must not be

+ *
+ * A backend that cannot be used here stays on the list carrying its reason. An
+ * option that silently is not there leaves a reader who was told this app reads
+ * folders with nothing to look at and nothing to do. A dead end with an exit is

- * judgement: never offer a dead end. The filesystem one needs an API only
- * Chromium has. The native one needs to be running inside the desktop app. The
- * in-memory one keeps nothing at all, so attaching it would produce a source
- * that looks like it works right up until the reader reloads the page.
+ * A backend that must never be offered is dropped, and there is exactly one.
+ * The in-memory reader keeps nothing, so attaching it would produce a source
+ * that looks like it works right up until the reader reloads the page. Greying
+ * that out would be advertising a footgun, so `selectable` false takes it off
+ * the list entirely and no reason is shown, because there is nothing the reader
+ * could do about it and nothing they should want to.

  * Each carries the fields it needs asking for, so the form that asks them knows
